answer: Consumers iterate MODEL_REFS.items(): ensure_global_store_and_models (deskops/bootstrap.py:74, loop :90) and init_local_store (deskops/bootstrap.py:103, loop :121); each entry goes through _add_model (bootstrap.py:146), which calls ModelCLI().add or `python -m sldb models add`. sldb never receives the dict itself.

__all__ (deskops/models/__init__.py) has 23 names, incl. PrimitiveDoc and OperationalArtifactDoc, so both are exported and must be filtered. Most concrete docs are indirect subclasses (HookDoc->PrimitiveDoc->StructuredNLDoc); issubclass is transitive, so include them. A direct-subclass-only check would drop 11 models.

Excluding 'the base classes PrimitiveDoc and OperationalArtifactDoc' is already stated; name-based and identity-based exclusion are equivalent because every __all__ name is that class's __name__ (deskops/models/__init__.py).

Key = class name verbatim (bootstrap.py:15-31; store_index `name` is the same, .sldb/core/store_index.yaml:3), value = 'deskops.models:<Name>'. Order is irrelevant to doctor (sorts, doctor.py:118) and only affects desk.py:199-200 output; no test asserts multi-model order.

Default must be False: direct callers main.py:87,95,113,137 call ensure_sldb_available() with no args and must not install; ensure_machine_ready (bootstrap.py:64-65) is the only site passing True. Use a keyword arg with default False.

Callers: main.py:87 (materialize), :95 (drift), :113 (add/edit/bind/next/list/show/advance), :137 (message/inbox/repo/unknown fallback), plus ensure_machine_ready bootstrap.py:65. 'list, show, add' in the rationale is a non-exhaustive example.

`deskops bootstrap` is a CLI command (parser.py:446-451) -> main.py:155-156 _bootstrap -> ensure_machine_ready; `deskops init` -> main.py:158-166 _init -> ensure_machine_ready. Both share ensure_machine_ready (bootstrap.py:64-65), so allow_install=True belongs there.

The install runner is SLDBBootstrap._run (bootstrap.py:207-215), invoked from ensure_sldb_available for the pip command (bootstrap.py:45-56); it wraps subprocess.run (bootstrap.py:208). Spy on either _run or deskops.bootstrap.subprocess.run.

SLDBBootstrap._sldb_importable uses importlib.util.find_spec('sldb') (bootstrap.py:180-181). Monkeypatch SLDBBootstrap._sldb_importable (or deskops.bootstrap.importlib.util.find_spec) to return False.

Top-level key `models:` is a list of mappings; each entry has `name` (.sldb/core/store_index.yaml:2-3), read as {m.name for m in idx.models} (bootstrap.py:166-168). Path is core/store_index.yaml (../sldb/src/sldb/store/layout.py:22-23).

`deskops init` is standalone: main.py:158-180 _init ensures the target dir, ensure_machine_ready, init_local_store, then scaffold_desk. No prior desk/ needed; the existing _init_repo does main(['init', str(root)]) on an empty dir (tests/test_doctor_model_registration.py:11-14).

Cross-file test imports exist (test_message_cli.py:22 `from test_cli import _setup_inbox_identity_env`), and the target file already has an in-process _init_repo helper (tests/test_doctor_model_registration.py:11-14). Either self-contained or reused helpers passes; not a blocker.

main() returns int (main.py:283 def main -> CLI().run); CLI.run catches SystemExit from parse_args and returns the code (main.py:59-62). Assert `main([...]) == 1`; existing tests do this (test_doctor_model_registration.py:29,48,58).

No init needed: the sldb gate at main.py:113-116 runs before OperationsCLI, and with _sldb_importable False + allow_install False it returns 1 before touching a store (bootstrap.py:37-43). `deskops list tasks` is valid (parser.py:915-929; --root defaults to '.').
Informational: Test A (step 3) asserts equality with the set derived from deskops.models.__all__ minus the two bases, not against the repo's own .sldb store. No repo-store assertion is required.

Pill is a boundary guardrail, not an acceptance criterion; doctor is out of scope (Scope section) and doctor already delegates store health to SLDB (doctor.py:117-124, :189) and never calls ensure_sldb_available. No doctor work needed.
